words.sceneBrief: A green frog jumps into a small pond with its legs stretched and a splash below.
A dentist uses a small dental mirror to check Sami's back tooth; a clear inset shows the molar.
Bright sunlight streams through a window onto a room floor.
A mountain is partly hidden by low white fog with its outline still visible.
An adult guest enters a house carrying a small gift as Sami welcomes him at the door.

words.sentence: تَضَعُ الْمُمَرِّضَةُ ضِمَادًا عَلَى يَدِ سَامِي.
words.sceneBrief: A nurse wraps a clean bandage around Sami's hand; no blood or visible injury.
Sami laughs with an open smile at a funny puppet held up by Layla.
Sami hugs his little brother warmly with both arms.
Sami presses one elevator call button with a fingertip in a hallway.
Sami hits a tennis ball with a racket on a safe sports court.
Layla peels a hard-boiled egg over a plate with small shell pieces beside it.
Layla washes carrots and cucumbers under running water in a kitchen sink.
A single green pencil lies beside a broad green scribble on white paper.
A clearly white rabbit sits on green grass with long ears fully visible.
Sami holds a tennis racket upright on a sports court; racket strings are clear.
A polished silver ring on a small dark display cushion, with a cool metallic sheen.
A ball lands on bare ground with a small dust puff below it.
Layla washes both hands under a tap above a clearly visible bathroom basin.
Sami rests in bed with a blanket and a thermometer on the bedside table, looking mildly unwell.
Sami runs along a garden path with bent arms and one foot off the ground.

microstories.title: ضِفْدَعٌ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ
sentences: يَرَى سَامِي ضِفْدَعًا أَخْضَرَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ.
sceneBriefs: Sami runs on a garden path beside a small pond.
Sami stops and spots a green frog on the ground beside the pond.
The same green frog jumps from the ground into the pond.
Sami smiles and points toward the frog floating safely in the pond.

microstories.title: وَجْبَةٌ لِلضَّيْفِ
sceneBriefs: An adult guest arrives at the door with a gift and Sami welcomes him.
Layla washes vegetables in the kitchen while the guest sits at a table in the background.
Layla peels a boiled egg beside the washed vegetables.
Layla presents a plate with the peeled egg and vegetables to the smiling guest.
